content.title: The Masked Singer Reveals Iconic TV Judge, Celebrity Offspring in Double Elimination
content.text: The Masked Singer Reveals Iconic TV Judge, Celebrity Offspring in Double Elimination0 seconds of 1 minute, 19 secondsVolume 0%The Masked Singer Reveals Iconic TV Judge, Celebrity Offspring in Double EliminationIt's time to say goodbye to not one, but two The Masked Singer season 14 contestants. Stingray and 14 Karat Carrot were both sent home after a double elimination during the Fox reality singing competition series' March 18 episode. First to go was 14 Karat Carrot, who performed Earth, Wind & Fire's "Shining Star" during Star Strek Night. But after landing in the bottom, Carrot got the boot and revealed himself to be TV legend Judge Greg Mathis. Robin Thicke was the only judge who correctly guessed the star's identity after some helpful clues from the 65-year-old, including the scales of justice embroidered on his costume's fanny pack. Plus, after Carrot teased fans by saying, "It's ironic being on this side of a panel of judges when I'm usually the one doing the judging," Thicke was certain the Mathis Family Matters alum was behind the gold veggie suit.But Mathis wasn't the only star sent home. Stingray's rendition of The Weeknd's "Starboy" wasn't impressive enough to guarantee him another week of competition, and he was eliminated as well. As it turned out, the famous face behind the undersea disguise was Evan Ross, son of recording legend and "Queen of Motown" Diana Ross.Michael Becker/FOX/Unique Nicole/Getty ImagesThanks to some helpful hints—including a bedazzled glove reminiscent of Michael Jackson's—the panel was pointed in the right direction. As Ross teased before his reveal, "I've been surrounded by a lot of amazing people since I was very young. Michael one of them, but the best part about him was he always made me believe that everything was magic." In a rare move, all four judges were in agreement and collectively guessed it was the 37-year-old behind the mask.Michael Becker/FOX/Marc Piasecki/WireImageRoss' reveal was surprising given that season 14 guest judge Kelly Osbourne firmly stated during a previous episode that she believed Galaxy Girl was actually Ashlee Simpson. If the former Fashion Police judge was correct, that would mean Ross and Simpson did the show together as a married couple. But only time will tell if Osbourne's guess is correct as Galaxy Girl has yet to be unmasked. Keep reading to see all the celebs who have been revealed so far this season on The Masked Singer.
